# The Federalist

> > Conservative news and commentary covering politics, policy, culture, and current events with analysis from writers like Ben Domenech, David Harsanyi, and Scott Lincicome.

The Federalist is a web magazine providing right-leaning political analysis and cultural commentary. The site covers major policy debates including healthcare reform (ObamaCare/Affordable Care Act), education policy (Common Core), foreign policy, and Republican Party politics, while also offering perspectives on social issues, media criticism, and American culture.

## Key Topics

- ObamaCare/Affordable Care Act
- Republican Party politics
- Healthcare policy
- Obama administration
- Policy analysis
- Cultural commentary
- Media criticism
- Religious liberty
- Common Core education
- Unemployment benefits
- Foreign policy (Putin/Ukraine)
- Abortion regulations
- 2016 presidential candidates
- Congressional procedures (filibuster/nuclear option)
- Political correctness

## Healthcare and the Affordable Care Act

- [What Was the Point of ObamaCare?](https://thefederalist.com/2014/03/11/what-was-the-point-of-obamacare): Critical analysis of Affordable Care Act's failure to insure uninsured
- [What Dreams May Come For The Post-Obamacare World](https://thefederalist.com/2014/01/28/what-dreams-may-come-for-the-post-obamacare-world): Conservative healthcare proposals measured against ObamaCare alternatives

## Politics and Elections

- [How to Kick Putin in the Teeth](https://thefederalist.com/2014/03/05/how-to-kick-putin-in-the-teeth): Foreign policy strategy for crushing Putin's Ukraine/Crimea ambitions
- [The Way Too Early Roundup Of 2016 Republican Candidates](https://thefederalist.com/2014/02/21/the-way-too-early-roundup-of-2016-republican-candidates): Ben Domenech's early assessment of 2016 GOP presidential candidates
- [Nuclear Option: The GOP Shouldn't Unilaterally Disarm](https://thefederalist.com/2013/11/20/nuclear-options-gop-should-call-harry-reids-bluff): David Harsanyi on GOP response to Harry Reid's filibuster reform threat
- [Ed Gillespie Is Exactly The Type Of Candidate Republicans Don't Need](https://thefederalist.com/2014/01/16/ed-gillespie-is-exactly-the-type-of-candidate-republicans-dont-need): David Harsanyi critiques GOP establishment candidate Ed Gillespie

## Policy Analysis

- [Common Core: The Biggest Election Issue Washington Prefers to Ignore](https://thefederalist.com/2013/11/25/common-core-biggest-election-issue-washington-prefers-ignore%e2%80%a8): Analysis of Arne Duncan's Common Core defense and growing state opposition
- [Like The Rest Of Us, Krugman Doesn't Know If North Carolina's 'Experiment' Is Working](https://thefederalist.com/2014/01/14/like-the-rest-of-us-krugman-doesnt-know-if-north-carolinas-experiment-is-working): Scott Lincicome critiques Paul Krugman on NC unemployment benefits analysis
- [What North Carolina Teaches Us About Unemployment Benefits And Confirmation Bias](https://thefederalist.com/2013/12/19/north-carolina-teaches-us-unemployment-benefits-confirmation-bias): Data-driven analysis of North Carolina unemployment benefits experiment
- [Americans Should Have A Beef with Uncle Sam over Rising Meat Prices](https://thefederalist.com/2013/11/01/americans-beef-uncle-sam-rising-meat-prices): Scott Lincicome on government policy impact on rising meat prices
- [The Real Problem With Short-Term Continuing Resolutions](https://thefederalist.com/2013/10/18/real-problem-short-term-crs): Dan McConchie on wasteful federal spending from short-term budget CRs

## Social Issues and Religious Liberty

- ['Compossibility' And Religious Liberty](https://thefederalist.com/2014/03/03/compossibility-and-religious-liberty): Analysis of religious liberty vs gay rights using compossibility concept
- [Virginia's Blood-Spattered Abortion Clinics And Onerous Hallway Widths](https://thefederalist.com/2013/10/25/virginias-blood-spattered-abortion-clinics-lies-tell-ourselves-womens-health-care): Virginia abortion clinic safety violations vs regulatory requirements debate
- [Five Key Lessons On Presidents Day From Abraham Lincoln](https://thefederalist.com/2014/02/18/five-key-lessons-on-presidents-day-from-abraham-lincoln): Presidents Day reflection on Lincoln's classical liberalism and principles

## Cultural Commentary

- [The Word 'Bully' Has Lost All Meaning](https://thefederalist.com/2013/11/13/the-word-bully-has-lost-all-meaning): Cultural commentary on NFL's Richie Incognito controversy and bullying term
- [Google Glass And The End of Racism](https://thefederalist.com/2014/01/07/google-glass-end-racism): Tech commentary on Google Glass potential to combat discrimination
- [5 Stupidest Myths Non-Sports Fans Will Push At Your Super Bowl Party](https://thefederalist.com/2014/02/01/the-5-stupidest-myths-non-sports-fans-will-push-at-your-super-bowl-party): Rachel Lu debunks common Super Bowl myths from non-sports fans
- [Gimme Shelter Is A Pro-Life Film, But It's Not A Courageous One](https://thefederalist.com/2014/01/31/gimme-shelter-is-a-pro-life-film-but-its-not-a-courageous-one): Film review critiquing Vanessa Hudgens' pro-life movie Gimme Shelter

## Optional

- [The Joys of Hate-Reading Matt Monahan](https://thefederalist.com/2013/11/06/the-joys-of-hate-reading-matt-monahan): Literary criticism of Matt Monahan's tech bro novel and startup culture
- [In Defense Of Sexy Flags](https://thefederalist.com/2013/10/22/defense-sexy-flags): Ed Mitchell defends traditional state flag designs against modernization
